newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai posts 12.1 percent GDP growth in Jan-Aug.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai posts 12.1 percent GDP growth in Jan-Aug.

text.p: Shanghai's gross domestic product (GDP) in the first eight months was 178.942 billion yuan, an increase of 12.1 percent over the same 1995 period, the city's statistical bureau said.

GDP output in August alone was 23.799 billion yuan, an increase of 13.6 percent over August 1995 and compared to a year-on-year growth of 10.5 percent in July 1996, the Business News on Tuesday quoted the bureau as saying.
In the first eight months, fixed asset investment was 74.602 billion yuan, an increase of 37.6 percent over the same 1995 period, the bureau said.
In August alone, the city's consumer retail sales were 9.342 billion yuan, an increase of 14.9 percent over a year earlier, it said.

In August alone, the city's exports were $1.155 billion, an increase of 18.6 percent over a year earlier, and contracted foreign investment $849 million in 246 projects, it said but gave no comparative figure.
